class.name: VASourceRelative
class.description: A non-spatialised sound source for sounds made by the player's own character (e.g. footsteps, gunshots). It isn't raytraced or muffled, and is sent to the current [VAListener]'s reverb. The listener's reverb is silent until the listener has its first raytraced reverb, so calling [method play] before this source is ready to play (see [method is_ready_to_play]) waits, and starts playback once it is. If [member ALSource.autoplay] is [code]true[/code], playback starts automatically once it's ready. [method stop] cancels that wait. A [VAListener] casts no reverb rays by default, so give it [member VAEmitter.reverb_ray_count] and [member VAEmitter.reverb_bounce_count] for relative sources to have reverb.

method.name: is_ready_to_play
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the current [VAListener] has its first raytraced reverb, or never will (it casts no reverb rays, or is outside the [VAWorld]'s bounds). Also [code]true[/code] if OpenAL has no EFX. Returns [code]false[/code] while there's no listener.
